title: AuditRow
description: Canonical fasten audit row (NDJSON stdout, shape=audit). This file is the single source of truth for enum vocabulary and redact rules — generated into all language adapters by spec/codegen.py.

wire_version.description: Schema version; readers MUST tolerate higher values on best-effort.

origin_id.description: Dedup key for replication; equals id on first emission.

monotonic_seq.description: Per-node counter, allocated by the audit store; orders rows whose timestamps tie. 0 on a row no store has allocated.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 with a Z suffix and microsecond precision, e.g. 2026-06-15T10:30:45.123456Z. The Swift SDK writes whole seconds.

x-values.warn: Potentially problematic, not yet an error

actor_kind.description: WHO anchor — who initiated the action.

x-values.user: Human user (browser, mobile, CLI on behalf of a user)

domain.description: Adopter-defined domain, e.g. node, user, billing.

method.description: HOW anchor — how the event was triggered.

x-values.cli: CLI command typed by a human
x-values.ui: Web or desktop UI action, human-initiated
x-values.sdk: Direct SDK call, no transport shim active. Default.

request_id.description: Correlation id, never empty. Most SDKs mint 12 hex characters. An HTTP shim keeps a caller's X-Request-ID when it is 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. Background work gets <kind>-<service_id>-<12 hex>, and a caller can set any id in code, so the schema sets no pattern.

detail.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs; secret keys are redacted. null once retention has redacted the row (spec §7.1).

pii_in_detail.description: True when the row's code is registered with pii_in_detail, so retention redacts its detail.

shipped_at.description: Set when row has been relayed upstream.

prev_hash.description: On a sealed row, the hash of the node's last sealed row before it in the source_node_id chain (spec §2.1), or the sentinel 'genesis' when there is none.

hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of canonical JSON of this row with the 'hash' key excluded. Empty string on unsealed rows (written before hash-chain support, or allocated without sealing, spec §8.2).

canonical_form_id.description: Which canonical form the hash was computed over (spec §1.4). Absent means "1".

detail_salt.description: Form "2": the salt of detail_commitment. Stored, not hashed; empty once the row is redacted. null or absent on a row that is not sealed yet.

detail_commitment.description: Form "2": hex SHA-256 over detail_salt and the canonical JSON of detail. The row hash covers this in place of detail, so detail can be redacted without breaking the chain.

RetentionClass.description: Row retention bucket — on Meta, not in the wire row itself.

x-fasten-redact.description: PII/secret field keys scrubbed from Row.detail before persistence. Keys are preserved; only values are replaced.
notes: Patterns match field keys, not values.
[_-]? — separator is optional: api_key, api-key, apikey all match.

dsn$ matches only at the end of a key, so goodsName is kept. [_-]pwd$ needs a separator before it, so db_pwd matches and PWD or OLDPWD do not. A bare key or auth is not matched; add them with extra_redact_keys if needed.
Adopters may add keys via init(extra_redact_keys=[...]) but never remove defaults.
